Broadstreet HEOR
Broadstreet Health Economics & Outcomes Research (Vancouver, Canada)is a consultancy running health-economics and real-world-evidencestudies for Pfizer, Bayer, Boehringer Ingelheim, Takeda, Madrigal,Alexion/AstraZeneca, Bristol-Myers Squibb, Sarepta, Taysha, Biohavenand others.- US patient PHI: Medicaid (11.3M rows: DOB, race, diagnoses, NDCdrugs, payments), Veradigm/Allscripts EHR tables, licensed IBMMarketScan / Optum Clinformatics data.- Production Alexiondb (PostgreSQL): schema + claims rows.- Live SQL Server credentials of client Taysha Gene Therapies(production DB irsf-nhs-prod-db, public IP).- Confidential pharma materials: unpublished Boehringer Ingelheimslides, Takeda manuscript, Bayer CEM models, Madrigal reports,Pfizer/VA emails.- Staff personal documents.
